principle: Following Deutsch's fallibilist emphasis, explanations are conjectures subject to comparison and criticism; no numerical fit alone is a universal physical explanation.

hypotheses.engineering: Nested training-only CV can select more suitable analytic families than the R1.1 bounded single/two-term selector.
hypotheses.primary: On new observed NIST calibration datasets, candidate equations must demonstrate >=5% better test RMSE than a validation-selected simple regression baseline in both datasets before any competitiveness claim.
hypotheses.null: On independently permuted validation labels, discoverer must ABSTAIN; fail if it claims a law.

prospective_datasets.study: Ultrasonic reference block response vs metal distance

split: Group all identical x observations. Order distinct x ascending, use index % 5: 0 TEST, 1 VALIDATION, other TRAIN. Source rows preserve original order. No source read by discoverer except generated train+validation input. Entire fixture public; test is held out by process, not cryptography.

selection_algorithm.inner_cv: For each candidate family and fixed nonlinear grid shape, grouped 3-fold CV within TRAIN only, using distinct x group sorted index modulo 3. Minimize train-CV RMSE. Refit winning shape on all TRAIN.
selection_algorithm.validation_score: RMSE(validation)/sd_y_train + 0.008 * number_of_parameters; count nonlinear shape parameters in model complexity: Gaussian 4, exp_decay 3, rational_exp 4; polynomial d+1, constant 1.
selection_algorithm.selection_gate: Only PROPOSE if validation RMSE < 0.98 * best validation RMSE among constant, linear, quadratic and cubic polynomial models fitted on TRAIN. Else ABSTAIN, no promotion.
selection_algorithm.dataset_negative_controls: For each dataset create negative case: use unchanged TRAIN but validation y cyclically shifted by floor(n_validation/2), reusing all points; the same discoverer method must ABSTAIN.
selection_algorithm.minimum_generalization: Real TEST held out until independent witness; if candidate proposed, compare test RMSE to baseline selected on validation among degrees 0..3. Report candidate lost/won/tied and all negative cases, including nonproposals.
selection_algorithm.guard: If holdout, source SHA, sample/split, malformed model or control mismatches then fail. TEST performance must NEVER be used to retune grid, threshold or family for this round.

baseline: OLS polynomial 0/1/2/3 fitted on TRAIN, selection by validation normalized RMSE; independent verifier recomputes from NIST source text.

success_definition.software: CI discovers candidates deterministically, two independent runners verify source and corruption tests.
success_definition.controls: Both negative controls MUST ABSTAIN and four adversarial receipt mutations MUST FAIL.
success_definition.scientific_competitiveness: Both datasets PROPOSE and >=5% holdout RMSE improvement vs validation-selected baseline; else record NO_PROMOTION and negative result.
success_definition.metaphysics: Not tested; no claim of God existence, universal physical law or P=NP.

limits: Published NIST datasets and source model families are publicly known, not genuinely unknown to the scientific community.
NIST dataset metadata publishes theoretical functional families; predeclared search grammar may include them and is not free-form discovery.
This is model selection under finite sampled measurements, not independent physical replication or new science.
No performance assessment is allowed from old Pontius and Norris data.
